title: Garfield and His Nine Lives
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 6030 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Platformer. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): health 5 and lives 3 -> 2 after a death. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
A jump, B attack/throw
Garfield climbs, swims and pushes objects
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: The title says it: Garfield has nine lives through the adventure.
widgets.label: Lives

widgets.text: Each world gives Garfield a different costume and a new move set.
widgets.label: Abilities

widgets.text: Bosses have short attack cycles: wait for the opening after their attack, then strike.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Nine themed levels based on Garfield's "lives": each a different setting and era.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text:
Lasagna and food restore health.
Collectables are scattered in each level.
widgets.label: Pickups

widgets.text: Each level hides collectables; find them all for 100%.
widgets.label: Hidden items
